name: Kevin J.S. Duska Jr.

name: Kevin John Duska

name: Stefan (Štefan, Steve) Duska
note: Son of Michal Duska and Maria Demko by the 1947 certificate. Died 2018 and was known as Steve: stated by Kevin (ledger C-11), not documented. The Duska agent owns this entry.

name: Mihaly (Michal, Mike) Duska
note: Roman Catholic cottar of Senné in 1929; 'Mike Duska' in Montréal; married once, to Maria Demko; alive in November 1966. The Duska agent owns this entry. Not to be confused with Mihály Demkó, his father-in-law (ledger X-002).

name: Maria Demko (Mária Demkó, Mary Demko)
role: Great-grandmother. Head of this repo's line
note: Wife of Michal (Mike) Duska and mother of Štefan: documented by the 1947 certificate, the gravestone and the 1966 deed. Greek Catholic, of Iňačovce. Died 9 Sep 1950. The birth date and parents come from the 1906 civil registration; that she is the child in it rests on three points agreeing (name, Iňačovce, 1906) and not yet on a record that states it. See DM-H-010 and DM-H-015. Ledger X-017: no burial or death register for Iňačovce after 1906 is in hand, so it is not shown that the child of 1906 lived to marry; see data/necronym_checks.json.

name: Mihály Demkó

birth.date: c. 1882 (19 Aug 1882 if he is DM-X-001)

note: Greek Catholic agricultural day-labourer living at Solymos in August 1906, born at Magasrév, aged 24; signs his own name. Father of the Mária born 22 Aug 1906. Taken to be the Mihály baptised at Viszoka no. 132 on 20 Aug 1882 (DM-X-001): same name, rite, birthplace and age to the week. That identification is an inference until his marriage entry is found (DM-H-017). Ledger X-017: the burials of the Csicser parish for 1882 to 1897 are not in hand, so it is not shown that the child of 1882 lived. His age as written in 1906, 24, fits a birth between August 1881 and August 1882.

name: Mária Kocsis
note: Greek Catholic, born and living at Solymos, aged 20 in August 1906. Wife of Mihály Demkó. Opens the Kocsis line at Iňačovce. A baptism that may be hers is in hand: Mária, 28 Feb [1887], daughter of Mihály Kocsis and Mária Knyezső, Solymos no. 19 (DM-X-045, DM-H-031 at 58). Not attached yet.

name: Michael (Mihály, Miso) Demko, of Jesztreb
role: The older Mihály Demkó of Jesztreb
note: Greek Catholic cottar (inquilinus, zsellér) at Jesztreb, wife Maria Lazár. Children in hand: Maria, 21 Aug [1864] (no. 28); Michael, 14 or 15 Mar 1866 (no. 32); Anna, 12 Jan [1871] (no. 54); Susanna, 12 May [1875] (no. 33), died 10 Apr 1876; twins János and György, 27 Jun 1877; Erzsébet, 13 Aug [1884] (no. 47), died 11 Feb 1885; János, 21 Dec [1885] (no. 64). Seven house numbers in twenty-one years: a cottar who rented. Georgius Mazur and Maria Tamás stand godparents from 1864 to 1871. Father of the 'younger' Mihály (DM-H-033).

note: Son György, 11 Feb [1882]. The surname reads Koczák in both agents' readings. Kept as a negative.

name: Mary D[e]mko, wife of a Javor (chart)
role: A namesake of Ahn 9, born the same year. Not her
note: Demko or Danko: the chart is too small to say. Born in America, apparently at Passaic, New Jersey; a line of her box names Vysoká nad Uhom; mother of Ján Javor (1926 to 1991). Not Maria Demko, who was born at Solymos and died at Montréal in 1950 (DM-NC-015). From a compiled chart only.

name: Andrej D[e]mko and Mária M[...]ová, of Vysoká nad Uhom (chart)
role: Parents of DM-X-052; perhaps Demkos of the Viszoka families
note: She 1887 to 1979 by a photograph caption. His parents on the chart are a Ján D[..]ko and an Anna S[...] of the same village. A János Demkó with a wife Anna Szlekár is on record at Viszoka in [1874] (DM-X-015, DM-X-016); whether these are the same couple is not shown. See DM-H-034. From a compiled chart only.
